CHIEF MINISTER'S BREAKFAST SCHEME (MOTHER OF ALL WELFARE SCHEMES) 
 
1. 
Gist of the Scheme 
Provides nutritious hot cooked breakfast to primary school children studying in Classes 1 to 5 in Government schools across Tamil Nadu on all working days. 
 
2. 
Objective 
To eliminate hunger among primary school students, improve nutritional status, increase school attendance and retention, and relieve the burden on working mothers. 
 
3. 
Eligibility Criteria 
- All students studying in Classes 1st to 5th in Tamil Nadu Government primary, middle, and high schools.
- No income limit or caste restriction.
 
4. 
Benefits Provided 
Free nutritious breakfast (including Rava Upma, Semiya Upma, Wheat Rava, Pongal, Sambar, and Millets-based dishes) served every school working day before morning classes. 
 
5. 
Department 
Social Welfare and Nutritious Meal Programme Department & Rural Development and Panchayat Raj Department, Government of Tamil Nadu.
